summaries.title: TIP-I2V: A Million-Scale Real Text and Image Prompt Dataset for Image-to-Video Generation
summaries.perspective: 本研究聚焦于**视觉生成与世界模型**（Vision & World）赛道，属于算法与架构创新。针对当前领域面临的「安全对齐脆弱性、隐私版权与潜在失控风险」痛点，作者围绕 **TIP-I2V** 展开攻关，核心切入概念涵盖视觉生成与世界模型（Vision & World）。核心论点主张：In this paper, we introduce TIP-I2V, the first large-scale dataset of over 1.70 million unique user-provided Text and Image Prompts specifically for Image-to-Video generation。
summaries.experiments: 技术路线上采用针对性模型架构设计与多维受控实验验证。结合代表性公开任务与受控消融设置开展系统评测。实验设计与验证细节：However, despite their popularity, these models rely on user-provided text and image prompts, and there is currently no dedicated dataset for studying these prompts。
summaries.conclusions: 实证分析表明：核心实验发现验证了所提方案的有效性与边界条件（Additionally, we provide the corresponding generated videos from five state-of-the-art image-to-video models）。
